mechanism: Memantine is an NMDA antagonist that may potentiate monoaminergic effects of tranylcypromine (irreversible MAOI), increasing risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis through additive CNS monoamine elevation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination deemed necessary, use lowest doses with careful monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms, hypertensive episodes, and CNS toxicity.
